anchors.description: Named tracked points the rig reports per frame (the heron's beak_tip is the v1 example). Effects and QA refer to anchors by name, never to species internals.

module.description: Python module exposing build_clip(kind, kwargs, ctx) -> (poses, events).

roster.description: The clip roster as DATA (replaces v1's clip_specs() code and the load-bearing clip-name conventions).

ambient.description: True for clips whose residuals fit the dynamics model (v1: idle kinds).

hooks.description: Named package hook functions the corpus builder runs after render (v1 examples: toss_patch, turn_squash).

mirror.description: Also build the mirrored variant (facing flip).

split.description: Explicit train/val split (replaces v1's name-suffix convention).

life_layer.description: Micro-motion that keeps held poses alive (generalizes the sine layers hard-coded in v1 clips.sample_clip). Applied by the engine sampler, scaled by 'stillness' conditions declared per term.

damped_by.description: Pose param whose value scales this term down (heron: neck_coil damps sway while aiming).

skip_when.description: Pose param that disables this term when > 0.5 (heron: flying disables body bob).

model_sheet.description: Path (package-relative) to the model-sheet document: proportions as ratios, canonical poses, parts that may never change shape.

role.description: e.g. body, accent, outline, prey, ink

palette.description: Named palette entries. Index 0 is ALWAYS the canvas/background entry. 'ink' is the reserved name for the environment's caused-mark color when the species shares it.

pose_params.description: Every animatable parameter of the rig, with its neutral default. Dotted names (leg_near.fx) address sub-dicts, exactly as the v1 Anim engine did.

contract.description: render(pose, ctx) -> (uint8 index grid, {anchor_name: (x, y) in GRID coords}). ctx carries grid size, design mapping, palette index map.

module.description: Python module inside the package exposing the render contract.
